response.original_title: 🎧⟦American_ExecutiveSupport⟧   ~How do I escalate a problem with  American  Airlines?
response.overview: To escalate a problem with  American  Airlines, call +1 866-673(1632) or +1 (855)671-1508. A customer service representative can review your issue related to booking changes, flight status, seat upgrades, travel assistance, or policy concerns. Clearly explaining your situation and providing your confirmation code helps ensure your case is prioritized and directed to the right department. If needed, the agent can escalate your concern to a supervisor for faster resolution. For follow-up or updates, contact +1 866-673(1632) or +1 (855)671-1508.
